releases.notes:
## What's changed

- Added a Forge 1.20.1 build with bundled Kotlin and Caffeine.
- Added Forge config-screen and targeted shape-highlight integration.
- Shared client configuration and debug rendering between Fabric and Forge.
- Switched VoxLib's development sources from Yarn to official Mojang mappings.
- Added loader suffixes to distributable filenames. Fabric keeps the `voxlib` Maven coordinate; Forge uses `voxlib-forge`.
- Ported the Fabric mod and common library to Minecraft 1.20.1.
- Updated Fabric API and Mod Menu for 1.20.1.
- Migrated the settings screen to Minecraft's `GuiGraphics` rendering API.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric and Forge
- Java 17

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Mystery2099/VoxLib/compare/v1.6.1%2B1.19.4...v1.6.1%2B1.20.1

mods.name: Mystery2099's VoxLib
mods.description: A convenience library for creating, combining, transforming, debugging, and selectively reusing voxel shapes in Minecraft modding.

releases.notes:
## Highlights

- Specialized identity-based caching for repeated voxel-shape unions and transformations
- Lower-allocation balanced unions and allocation-free transformation coordinate handling
- Lazy memoization for finite `CommonShapes` factories
- Reduced transient allocation for 256-box simplification
- Reproducible JMH benchmarks and scoped performance acceptance gates
- Exact occupied-volume, JVM API compatibility, cache concurrency, and dedicated-server loading coverage

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.19.4
- Java 17
- Existing VoxLib public API signatures are unchanged
- VoxLib remains convenience-first; fixed shapes should still normally be stored as constants

## Validation

- 90 automated tests passed on the tagged source
- Ubuntu and Windows Java 17 CI passed
- The complete three-fork `performanceCheck` passed before the metadata-only release bump

See [Performance benchmarks](https://github.com/Mystery2099/VoxLib/blob/v1.6.1%2B1.19.4/docs/PERFORMANCE.md) for methodology, limitations, and representative results.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mystery2099/VoxLib/compare/v1.6.0%2B1.19.4...v1.6.1%2B1.19.4

mods.name: Mystery2099's VoxLib
mods.description: A library that provides utilities for manipulating, creating, and rotating voxel shapes in Minecraft modding, with performance optimizations and common shape patterns.

releases.notes:
## What's changed

- Added persisted client debug settings with validation and safe partial-file loading.
- Added a native configuration screen with debug-mode, color, transparency, and reset controls.
- Added optional Mod Menu integration.
- Added independent targeted outline and collision overlays.
- Added client-side guards so rendering code does not load on dedicated servers.
- Fixed cache hash collisions returning unrelated shapes.
- Fixed empty bounding-box simplification and invalid box-limit handling.
- Added asymmetric rotation coverage and replaced placeholder tests with explicit skips.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.19.4
- Fabric
- Java 17

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Mystery2099/VoxLib/compare/v1.4.0%2B1.19.4...v1.6.0%2B1.19.4
